notes: ~57.5k Vancouver parcels -> PMTiles + H3 hexes. Source: Clark County GIS one-stop "Taxlots" layer (geometry + MktLandVal/MktBldgVal + PropertyUseClass + TaxStat), clipped to the City of Vancouver by the assessor jurisdiction tag JurisDesc='Vancouver' (see run_vancouver.py). Condos are mapped at the complex level by the county (smoke alarms clean, land $/sqft max ~343), so no per-unit stub merge is needed. Neighborhood region show/hide toggles (Land Value 3D + Parking). 63 City of Vancouver Neighborhood Associations (augment_vancouver_regions.py); the bake emits metadata.groups.neighborhood (neighborhood is in H3_CATEGORICAL_FIELDS).
